positive_triggers: A feature, migration, architecture, policy, or audit-repair candidate needs design before delivery
Consequential design alternatives, decision dependencies, or uncertainties remain
The user asks to grill or stress-test a selected plan and preserve the result in design documents
The user wants a deep high-bandwidth interview with batched questions and expert rationales
negative_triggers: Generate tickets or an implementation plan
Authorize or verify completed production work
preconditions: A direction is selected or can be confirmed as selected
applicability.confidence_or_escalation_rule: Inspect permitted evidence before questioning; stop or route elsewhere when selection, authority, or permission boundaries cannot be established.

policy.primary_pattern: shared-evidence-recon-backed exhaustive sweep-driven design interrogation with conditional graph escalation

interview_engine.batching_policy: maximum coherent consequential active set (flat open decisions or graph frontier)
interview_engine.answer_burden_policy: Use answer burden to improve grouping, compression, and response ergonomics; do not suppress an independent consequential decision merely to reduce count.
interview_engine.sweep_depth_driver: decision uncertainty, consequence, and evidence surface; never expected diff size, line count, or ticket label

decision_model.canonical_state: stable decision records represented as either a flat decision set or a dependency graph
decision_model.representation_policy: run mandatory coverage sweep first; use flat mode when decisions are independent; materialize graph only when meaningful topology exists

flat_mode.structure: flat decision set with stable IDs, evidence, owner, state, recommendation, rationale, quality receipt, and resolution
flat_mode.packet_selection: all independent consequential open human decisions that are evidence-ready and pass the question-quality gate

graph_mode.structure: directed acyclic dependency graph, or tree when single-parent
materialization_triggers: fact dependencies that gate human decisions
multi-round evolution where prior answers change eligibility
graph_mode.research_frontier: discoverable fact nodes whose prerequisites are settled
graph_mode.decision_frontier: human-decision nodes whose prerequisites and fact dependencies are settled
graph_mode.packet_selection: all independent consequential eligible frontier decisions that pass the question-quality gate

graph_non_triggers: task label such as architecture, design, or migration
expected implementation diff size or line count
decision_model.zero_edge_graph_policy: prefer flat mode when no meaningful edges or branch relationships exist

dynamic_promotion.trigger: meaningful topology appears after later evidence or answers

question_quality.failure_action: rewrite, merge, split, research, or discard before presentation

steps: Bound direction, authority, permissions, artifact depth, and interview intensity
Inspect evidence through a validated shared Evidence Recon v1 packet, self-scaling inline or expedition
Run the mandatory coverage sweep and seed stable candidate decision records
Launch proportional specialist research, question-discovery, and critique lanes
Research discoverable facts and overgenerate candidate questions
Deduplicate, sharpen, critique, and quality-gate the candidate pool
Analyze meaningful topology and materialize a flat decision set or dependency graph
Ask the maximum coherent recommendation-led packet
Adapt canonical decision state and documents after every answer bundle or bulk acceptance
Re-evaluate topology after every answer bundle and promote flat state when needed
Establish domain language and durable decisions
Compare mechanisms or prototype only when needed
Adversarially challenge the emerging contract and rerun coverage
Confirm shared understanding and seek human approval
branches: Research facts without asking the user
Do not block unrelated decisions on running research
Use as many non-overlapping specialist lanes as the uncertainty warrants
Use one-level conditional subquestions only when the parent answer cleanly activates the child branch
Preserve unanswered questions as open even when other questions are bulk-accepted
Stay flat when no meaningful topology exists
Promote flat state to graph mode when topology appears without restarting the interview
Stop only when all consequential records are accounted for and a fresh quality-gated coverage sweep finds no consequential omission
Use formal artifacts only when warranted
Hand off to strict hardening only when authorization-grade validation is required
authoritative_sources: Repository instructions and durable project artifacts within their authority

evidence_model.mode_policy: select inline for narrow bounded evidence; expedition for wide heterogeneous or high-completeness evidence surfaces
evidence_model.negative_claim_rule: absence claims require explicit coverage receipts before they can enter safe_to_assume
evidence_model.consumer_boundary: Evidence Recon establishes what available evidence supports; it never replaces the mandatory decision-coverage sweep, human decision ownership, or flat-vs-graph topology analysis.
evidence_model.fact_handling: settle discoverable facts from validated evidence; keep unresolved facts visible; never ask the human to restate discoverable facts

success_conditions: The active Evidence Recon v1 packet validates, its limitations remain visible, and no unsupported negative claim is treated as safe fact
Every consequential canonical decision-state record is accounted for
When graph mode is active, the decision frontier is empty and every consequential branch is accounted for
A final coverage and candidate-generation sweep in the active representation yields no consequential question that survives the quality gate
Adversarial review leaves no unowned contradiction
The human confirms the shared-understanding summary
A human-approved design and rollout contract exists, or exact approval blockers are recorded
Delivery can proceed without inventing core requirements
failure_conditions: After graph materialization, dependency topology is incoherent or cyclic and cannot be reframed
A blocking evidence conflict has no authoritative owner
Required Evidence Recon validation fails or a blocking factual conflict cannot be reconciled
stop_conditions: Every consequential record is evidenced, decided, derived, invalidated, accepted, or explicitly deferred with owner and revisit trigger
When graph mode is active, the decision frontier is empty and all consequential branches are accounted for
Fresh coverage and question-craft passes produce no additional consequential quality-gated questions in either flat or graph mode
Shared understanding has been explicitly confirmed
rollback_or_recovery: Preserve draft documents, canonical decision state, representation mode, evidence, candidate-question receipts, and unresolved records
Preserve stable IDs and settled state during flat-to-graph promotion
Route strict validation to a separate capability

inputs: optional pre-existing Evidence Recon v1 packet/reference
outputs: validated Evidence Recon v1 packet/reference with limitations and handoff summary
canonical decision state in flat or graph form
representation rationale and any promotion receipt
allowed_tools: Read-only repository and permitted research tools
Bounded specialist agents or installed skills for research, question discovery, and critique
side_effects: Writes design documentation only; never implementation
